name: Fu Yu Property Co., Ltd.
summary: Fu Yu Property Co., Ltd., based in Taichung, Taiwan, primarily operates within the residential real estate sector, overseeing the development, leasing, and sale of properties throughout the country. Beyond its focus on homes, the company also constructs factories and manages diverse building projects, from their initial creation to subsequent leasing, contracting, and final sale. Established in 1977, the firm was formerly known as Spring Rain Development Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to Fu Yu Property Co., Ltd. in September 2013.
